Problems we help solve

Facing one of these on your line?

Get in touch with ISHA Hot Melt Lamination Service — let's solve your lamination problem.

Bubbles & blisters

Analysis of bubble formation and recommendations for improving the lamination process.

Wrinkles & fabric distortion

Troubleshooting fabric tension, alignment, temperature and process-related wrinkle problems.

Poor bonding / delamination

Identifying possible causes of weak adhesion and helping optimize the bonding process.

Uneven adhesive application

Support for improving adhesive coating/application consistency and overall lamination quality.

High fabric tension

Technical guidance to achieve better fabric handling and stable lamination.

TPU lamination defects

Troubleshooting common TPU-to-fabric bonding and appearance-related defects.

Ways we work with you

Pick the support that fits your line

Three ways to keep a machine covered — a scheduled visit, ongoing floor support, or pay-as-you-run.

Regular service visit

Working hours: 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM. A technician comes to your factory on a set schedule for routine checks and upkeep.

Production running support

Available during production runs, 24 hours, no issue. Support stays on call for the full length of the run.

Meter basis service

Available on a per-meter basis — pay for service in line with what actually runs through the machine.

How we work

Our Approach

A structured way of getting from "there's a problem" to stable, consistent production.

01

Understand

We first understand your material, adhesive, process and production problem.

02

Analyze

We analyze the visible defect and possible process-related causes.

03

04

Optimize

We help optimize relevant process parameters for better, more consistent results.

05

Support

We provide practical technical guidance to help maintain stable production.
